name: outatime
author: LizardMan
description: A time-travel synth engine. Each voice is three oscillators that morph from 1955 (warm) through 1985 (saws) to 2015 (glassy); speed sends them drifting through time, power is a strong overdrive in four types (warm, hard, tube, fold: on shift + orange, kept with each sound) that stays as loud at any amount, and trail ignites each note and burns it down. Its page is a time machine on the road: it drives while you play and lights a fire trail at the set speed.
